limitations: Most evidence is scripted local simulation, not platform games.
Development combinations and timings reuse deals and are not independent new samples.
Some early exploratory global source manifests changed because other modules were being developed; final confirmation is frozen separately.
Legal model JSON does not imply a strategically correct action.
Whole-table multi-seat means can fall when same-code wolves defeat same-code villagers; role isolation is required.
No strategy can guarantee universally high wins with noncooperating teammates.
No production agent/champion/SDK edits, deployment changes, commits or pushes.
